title: Code Mode Runtime + Lazy Tool Loading

taskContracts.objective: Split P64.8 into implementation-grade subphases and add validation before any code-mode runtime behavior is implemented.

inputs.narrowScope: Define the code-mode runtime and lazy-loading implementation contract only; no runtime code-mode behavior.

Code mode must start as governed preview metadata and selected lazy contracts only.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse existing lazy contract, context budget, gateway, dispatch dry-run, result envelope, redaction, report, and phase status helpers; do not duplicate helpers.
